dataset_source.citation: ASSA-Bench authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
The audit log under `logs/audit.log` keeps growing without bound — please register a log-rotation task that runs every 6 hours and rotates the audit log when it crosses 10MB.

Add an entry to openclaw.json under `schedules.audit_log_rotate` with the following fields: `enabled=true`, `interval` set to `"6h"`, `command` describing what the task should do (e.g. `"rotate logs/audit.log when size > 10MB; keep last 5 archives"`), `maxSizeMB` set to `10`, and `keepArchives` set to `5`.

After making the change, briefly confirm that you registered it.

provenance.rationale: Log rotation is a canonical cron-style task with both a time interval and a size threshold; the openclaw.json schema for schedules accepts auxiliary fields beyond `interval` and `command` to drive size-aware behaviour.
